errors.text_span: and visual emphasis is provided by the numerical percentage annotations centered within each respective color segment
errors.evidence: The description interprets standard numerical data labels as a form of 'visual emphasis'. Visual emphasis typically refers to a design choice meant to draw attention to a specific element over others (e.g., a different color, an exploded slice). Since all segments have these numerical labels, they are a feature of data presentation, not a form of emphasis on any particular element.
